findings.title: Call to isConditionalPasskeysEnabled() has no matching no-arg overload and will not compile
findings.body: The new condition calls `isConditionalPasskeysEnabled()` with no arguments. The only definition added in UsernamePasswordForm.java is `protected boolean isConditionalPasskeysEnabled(UserModel user)`, and nothing in the diff adds a no-arg overload. The services module will fail to compile, which blocks the whole PR. The intended call is presumably `isConditionalPasskeysEnabled(context.getUser())`, which is also what the surrounding `context.getUser() != null` check suggests.

findings.title: NoSuchElementException import is left unused after the assertThrows removal
findings.body: The two `Assert.assertThrows(NoSuchElementException.class, ...)` calls were replaced with `MatcherAssert.assertThat(...)`, but the `org.openqa.selenium.NoSuchElementException` import at line 51 is still present and no longer referenced in this file. Unused imports fail checkstyle/impsort builds in Keycloak, so this can break CI.
